title: Status-for-sovereignty compact and the white-dominant selector state
working_proposition: A vertically stratified coalition can exchange mass status restoration for expanded executive and founder-capital sovereignty: grievance and nested superiority legitimate the subordination of independent counterpower; public authority then controls selection, capital, procurement, infrastructure, and institutional succession; conditional multiracial incorporation legitimates the selector; and counterfactual foreclosure makes the preferred order appear meritocratic without requiring a central conspiracy or uniform private intent.
negative_constitution: No outside actor may convert contradiction, patterned outcome, affected-party evidence, or an alternative into a binding pause, correction, substitution, or value claim unless the protected center admits the challenge on terms the center controls.

racial_order_hypothesis.label: white_dominant_conditionally_multiracial
racial_order_hypothesis.definition: An institutional order may remain white-dominant when rules, burdens, classifications, defaults, remedies, and status allocations preserve a racial hierarchy while permitting sincere and sometimes powerful non-White incorporation on terms that validate the selector and do not create independent collective counterpower.
must_test: public contribution and private residual rights
racial_order_hypothesis.forbidden_shortcut: Demography, rhetoric, disparity, or individual success alone establishes the racial order.

patriotism_discriminator.question: When does patriotism or national-security language express ordinary collective purpose, and when does it legitimate a status hierarchy, narrow admissible knowledge, remove counterpower, or convert public authority into protected private control?
negative_controls: civic patriotism with equal standing and robust dissent
lawful industrial policy with complete denominators and public recovery
national-security action with bounded expiry and independent review
diverse coalition with effective collective counterpower
patriotism_discriminator.forbidden_inference: Patriotic or national-security rhetoric alone proves white supremacy, fascism, coordination, or coercive operation.

four_gate_discriminator.name: status_and_deservingness
four_gate_discriminator.question: Who is assigned honor, authenticity, productivity, loyalty, dependency, danger, contamination, or undeservingness?

four_gate_discriminator.forbidden_inference: insult or disagreement alone proves institutional hierarchy

four_gate_discriminator.name: epistemic_admissibility
four_gate_discriminator.question: Whose knowledge, contradiction, patterned outcome, or institutional expertise may count before the problem and option set are fixed?
four_gate_discriminator.required_record: qualified knower or affected party, evidence, reclassification, and admissibility rule
four_gate_discriminator.forbidden_inference: expert disagreement alone proves a ceiling-conversion event

four_gate_discriminator.name: material_conversion
four_gate_discriminator.question: Who controls the employment, publication, appointment, funding, procurement, data, accreditation, legal, or platform gate that makes the classification operative?
four_gate_discriminator.required_record: authority basis, exact instrument, selected and rejected denominator, and consequence
four_gate_discriminator.forbidden_inference: formal authority or policy preference alone proves abuse

four_gate_discriminator.name: correction_monopoly
four_gate_discriminator.question: Who can preserve evidence, stay action, shift the burden, reverse the decision, sustain an alternative, substitute the system, co-govern, exit, or recover value?
four_gate_discriminator.required_record: formal and practical remedy, timing, cost, durability, and observed outcome
four_gate_discriminator.forbidden_inference: formal process or criticism alone proves effective counterpower
